items.title: Is Coherent (COHR) Too Rich Or Still Reasonable On Cash Flow?
items.summary: Coherent has seen a very sharp share price run over the past few years, which naturally raises a simple question for you as an investor: Does the current valuation really line up with the cash flows the business is expected to generate? Coherent has delivered a very large 3 year return of about 9x, which puts a lot of weight on whether its cash generation can keep backing that kind of market enthusiasm. items.title: Coherent (COHR) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of materials and photonics company Coherent (NYSE:COHR) jumped 4.1% in the afternoon session after the company announced the expansion of its Pluggable Optical Line System portfolio designed to support artificial intelligence datacenter networks. According to a company press release, the expanded Pluggable Optical Line System portfolio features a full C-band, high-power variable-gain amplifier in a compact QSFP form factor. items.title: Netflix, Nucor, On Holding, Xenon, Accenture, Coinbase, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite rebounded to end Friday’s session slightly higher after spending most of the day in the red.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average ended lower as higher oil prices and bond yields weighed on equities.  Glassmaker  Corning  and optical networking stocks  Coherent  and  Lumentum  rose, while chip manufacturer  Intel  fell 0.2%.

items.title: Coherent's Datacenter Business Powers its Revenue Growth
items.summary: COHR's fiscal Q4 revenues climb to $2.05 billion as datacenter and communications demand drive nearly 79% of sales and offset industrial weakness.

items.title: What's Moving Markets Today?
items.summary: Major indexes edged lower as the yield on the 10-year Treasury note pushed past 5%. Markets have had a lot to digest this week: a quarter-point interest-rate hike, fluctuating fuel prices and big tech's P(doom)--aka the probability that AI results in a existentially catastrophic outcome, according to the Silicon Valley ecosystem.
